title: Everyday tasks. Real uncertainty.
text: For many seniors, a smartphone means independence. But unfamiliar screens can make everyday tasks difficult.

title: Scams exploit that uncertainty.
text: A convincing message or an urgent phone call can turn that uncertainty into risk.

title: Meet Kaki.
text: Meet Kaki, a voice-first companion designed to guide Singapore seniors and flag possible scams.

title: One clear next step.
text: Let's book a clinic appointment. Kaki highlights HealthHub and says, Ah Ma, tap here.

title: Guidance that stays with you.
text: It guides each choice: book an appointment, select Bedok Polyclinic, then choose a date and time.

title: A little more independence.
text: The appointment is confirmed. One instruction at a time, with every spoken step also shown as text.

title: A prize. A deadline. A risky link.
text: Next, a WhatsApp message promises a thousand-dollar voucher. It urges Ah Ma to claim a prize before the offer expires.

title: A moment to pause.
text: Kaki scores the message and shows a warning. The matched phrases explain why it was flagged.

title: A trusted person in the loop.
text: Ah Ma can check with family first. In this prototype, the family alert is simulated.

title: The risk can sound convincing.
text: Then, a caller claims to be a police officer. The demo transcript demands a transfer to a safe account.

title: Speak up before harm.
text: As the transcript is scored, Kaki warns Ah Ma to end the call.

title: Help in four languages.
text: Guidance and warnings support English, Mandarin, Malay and Tamil, with visible captions alongside speech.

title: See why a message was flagged.
text: The demo console also lets a presenter score messages and inspect matched phrases and the alert log.

title: Built toward IBM LinuxONE.
text: The project targets IBM LinuxONE for training and inference. This demo can also score locally in the browser.

title: Confidence, with a safety net.
text: Our goal: greater independence, earlier warnings, and family support. Real-world impact still needs user testing.

title: Kaki
text: Kaki. A little guidance. A moment to pause. More confidence, together.
